about: A single-point diamond dresser in a switchable magnetic holder, and an Al2O3 dressing stick, modelled from scratch where the placeholder lays them: the 2-1/2 x 2 x 1-1/2 in holder (black enamel housing, ground pole plates top and bottom with the brass split, the on/off lever on its end), a collar block clamping the 7/16 in dresser shank at 15 deg under a socket set screw, the brass setting coned to a 1/2 carat stone; the 1 x 1 x 6 in vitrified stick with eased, chipped edges and its working end worn round.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: draft; layout and sizes checked against the placeholder

dresser_enamel_black.about: the magnetic holder's black baked enamel

dresser_diamond.about: the diamond point: tiny, clear and glossy (factors only)

dresser_stick.about: vitrified aluminium-oxide dressing stick: grainy, matte grey-beige (the sand-cast pits read as grit)

unsure.what: the holder's form: the record says 'magnetic base' without a model; a switchable dresser holder of the common kind is assumed
the stick's colour: Al2O3 sticks come grey, white or tan; grey-beige chosen
